traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 2, 2nd ed., 1959), family 372 Liliaceae (wide sense, which held the lilies, Melanthiaceae, Colchicaceae and Smilacaceae of APG's Liliales): perianth of six segments in two whorls, mostly alike (petal-like tepals); Trillium and its kin have green sepals and coloured petals. The ovary is superior in most; Alstroemeriaceae, also in the order, have it inferior.
